items.text: I’m not sure why I’m getting downvoted it was just a genuine question haha.
Congrats man. My son is 8 weeks old today. Biggest, but best, life change you’ll ever have. Fatherhood has been awesome.

I just turned 27. My wife and I always had mutual feelings about having kids relatively young. I believe we want to try and have 2-3 by our early 30s.

It’s a nerve racking time during pregnancy, from the time she tells you she’s pregnant up until delivery. At times you’ll be like oh shit what did I do? But it’s so worth it.  Just make sure you and your wife make a good team haha.

You definitely won’t be disappointed.  The Buu Saga is so solid. Even if you know spoilers it’ll still be a good way to expand your knowledge and see transformations as they happen. 

I’ve watched DBZ I think three times through and I still love it every time even though I know what happens. Hope this helps.
